name: Apache CouchDB
summary: Contributing material generated by AI or LLMs is expressly forbidden, including code, documentation and commit messages, because such tools cannot assure Apache 2 licence compatibility or proper attribution.

evidence.quote: Thus, it is expressly forbidden to contribute material generated by AI, LLMs, and similar technologies, to the CouchDB project.
This includes, but is not limited to, source code, documentation, commit messages, or any other areas of the project.
